events.label: fix(db): PrismaPg requires explicit pg.Pool with SSL — config object form silently breaks Supabase pooler
events.desc:
PrismaPg({ connectionString }) creates the adapter but the underlying pool
never establishes SSL on the Supabase pooler (port 6543), causing every
Prisma runtime query to throw. This silently broke Auth.js VerificationToken
writes, receipt creates, and all DB operations in production.

Fix: pass new Pool({ connectionString, ssl: { rejectUnauthorized: false } })
explicitly so SSL terminates correctly against aws-1-us-east-1.pooler.supabase.com.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>

events.label: feat(sim): lattice_sim.py — structural load test for ADR-023
events.desc:
Conductor loop (folksonomist -> reinforce -> decay -> contrarian ->
calc-guard -> sentinel) over a synthetic receipt stream with preferential
attachment (the cyclic feedback that makes calcification possible).

Modes: anterior (forward load sim), posterior (recoil analysis), sweep
(maps the SUPERIONIC envelope over lambda/c/g), test (the pre-PR gate).

`test` asserts F1-F6 reproduce + envelope non-empty; exits 0/1. F1 calcify
needs pref-attach (cyclic regime, per deep research); F5 sensor-divergence
is real (node-share misses core concentration that gini catches). Gini is
the primary phase gauge; node-share is the divergent second proxy.

Certifies machinery + failure-mode reproduction ONLY. Emits PROVISIONAL/
SYNTHETIC receipts to gitignored exports/. PR stays BLOCKED until real-
corpus Zipf baseline (100+ receipts) per ADR-023.

events.label: feat(spec): ADR-023 superionic goal lattice + lattice-pressure ROM
events.desc:
Observability layer modeled as an inferred folksonomy DAG over receipts,
held in a superionic phase band by three governed counter-forces (edge
decay / contrarian pressure / Drift Sentinel) mapped per L0-L7 level.

Pressure constants are L7 meta-governance constants, never system-tunable
(self-tuning decay = NOTOMATION breach). Implementation gated at 100+
receipts (same gate as ADR-020); goal_edges overlay deferred to a future
schema ADR.

Adversarially grounded via 5-agent deep research — four over-claims
corrected in place (no monotone-complexity theorem; rising complexity is
enrichment not calcification; DAG well-motivated not computationally
required; irreducibility does not forbid declaration). Calcification
backing re-pointed to preferential-attachment dynamics.

events.label: feat(observatory): plug-and-play GitHub event explorer — rule engine + ingester
events.desc:
Static-first GitHub analytics on top of the hot-swap data layer. Point the
Observatory at any repo, define custom events declaratively, dataset drops
into the live switcher — no UI rebuild.

- scripts/event-rules.json: user-editable ruleset. First-match-wins mapping
  from GitHub signals (commit/pr/release/workflow) to Observatory events/risks
  with altitude (L5->L1) + type + conf. Predicates: subject/body regex,
  prefix/scope (conventional-commits), author, label, kind, status.
- scripts/event_rules.py: pure rule engine + offline self-test.
- scripts/github_ingest.py: fetch commits/releases (stdlib urllib, token from
  env) OR --from-json for offline/CI; applies ruleset; auto-derives the
  altitude deck; emits data.<name>.json + updates datasets.json. --name lets
  multiple views of one repo coexist.
- build_observatory.py: manifest now keyed by file (not slug) so heuristic and
  rules-engine views of the same repo coexist in the switcher.
- scripts/OBSERVATORY-INGEST.md: plug-and-play guide.

Validated end-to-end against 100 real arcs-v9 commits via GitHub MCP ->
data.arcs-v9-gh.json (40 events). Both datasets live in the switcher. No deps.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>

events.label: feat(observatory): hot-swappable JSON datasets — runtime/data split + switcher
events.desc:
Decouple the Observatory from its baked-in data.jsx so datasets can be
swapped at runtime without a rebuild/redeploy:

- runtime.jsx (new): static code module — token maps, helpers, and
  hydrateObservatory(payload) which installs EVENTS/RISKS/LAYERS/LEDGER +
  span + repo link onto window. The verbatim global contract the views read.
- data.<slug>.json (new): swappable payload the generator now emits instead
  of baking arrays into JS. datasets.json: switcher manifest.
- index.html: Root fetches datasets.json -> selected payload -> hydrate ->
  mount App. Dataset <select> re-hydrates + remounts (App key=file) with no
  page reload; ?data= deep-links a dataset. Honesty footer folded into React
  so it tracks the active dataset.
- deck.jsx: REPO_BASE/PROV_LEDGER made lazy (read window.REPO on call) so
  module-load no longer precedes hydrate.
- build_observatory.py: emits data.<name>.json + updates datasets.json;
  --out-dir/--label flags; runtime.jsx stays hand-maintained.

Views unchanged. JSX validated via @babel/parser. Payload refreshed to HEAD
5e0ce36 (span +14d). data.jsx removed.
